name: Landing page speed budgets
about: Speed budgets for the pages ads send visitors to. Timings are checked against OpenPPC's lab loads (--render) or a Lighthouse result (--psi or --lighthouse); sizes and the speed score need a Lighthouse result. A budget nothing measured shows as an info finding, so a CI job without the flag doesn't pass silently.

budgets.title: Landing pages over the phone speed budget
budgets.fix: Start with the line the note names: a slow Largest Contentful Paint is usually the hero image or a font, too much script is usually tags. The Speed section lists what to cut.
